name: Jenn Feng Industrial Tools Co., Ltd.
summary: Jenn Feng Industrial Tools Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells power, hand, and garden tools, and related components in Taiwan. The company offers green energy equipment, such as inverters; aquaculture facilities, including tube waterwheel aerators, submersible sewage pumps, and water pumps; and power tools, comprising heat guns, brushless hammer drill, 3 in 1 brushless angle grinder, polisher, sander, brushless impact wrench, brushless impact driver, impact driver, cordless driver drill, driver drill, chain saw, vacuum cleaner, blower, reciprocating saw, circular saw, high torque impact wrench, impact wrench, LED work light, lithium battery and chargers. It also provides LED driving light with position light, work light, and linear driving lights; and various driving lights. The company was formerly known as Jenn Feng New Energy Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jenn Feng Industrial Tools Co., Ltd. in July 2020. Jenn Feng Industrial Tools Co., Ltd. was founded in 1975 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
